title: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision Language Models via Geometric Logic Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2605.18162v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made striking progress, yet their spatial reasoning remains fragile. Models that answer an original input correctly can still fail under valid transformations with predictable answer mappings, revealing a gap between instance-level correctness and robust spatial reasoning. To address this, we propose Spatial Alignment via Geometric Evolution (SAGE), a self-evolving framework that improves robust spatial reasoning through geometric and linguistic duality operations. SAGE incorporates duality consistency into GRPO training, encouraging models to produce coherent answers across original and transformed inputs. SAGE co-evolves duality generation and solution, allowing the model to continually expose and address its own reasoning weaknesses. A dynamic operation pool identifies challenging operations and retires mastered ones, keeping training focused on informative duality signals. SAGE is model-ag

translated_title: 通过几何逻辑一致性实现视觉语言模型中的自进化空间推理
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已取得显著进展，但其空间推理能力仍然脆弱。能够正确回答原始输入的模型，在经历答案映射可预测的有效变换后仍可能失败，这揭示了实例级正确性与稳健空间推理之间的差距。为解决这一问题，我们提出了通过几何进化实现空间对齐（SAGE），这是一个通过几何和语言对偶操作来提升稳健空间推理能力的自进化框架。SAGE将对偶一致性融入GRPO训练中，鼓励模型在原始输入和变换输入之间产生连贯一致的答案。SAGE共同进化对偶生成与求解过程，使模型能够持续暴露并弥补自身的推理弱点。动态操作池会识别具有挑战性的操作并淘汰已掌握的操作，使训练始终聚焦于信息丰富的对偶信号。SAGE具有模型无关性（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出SAGE自进化框架，将几何与语言对偶一致性融入GRPO训练，并通过动态操作池聚焦难点，显著提升视觉语言模型在输入变换下的稳健空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: SAGE is a self-evolving framework that integrates geometric-linguistic duality consistency into GRPO training with a dynamic operation pool, enabling vision-language models to achieve robust spatial reasoning under valid input transformations.
